title: EvidenceBranchRepository
responsibility: Appends immutable record directories to the evidence branch and reads them back.

inputs.name: EvidenceBranchRepository.constructor.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root passed to EvidenceTreeAdapter when the repository is constructed. This class does not normalize or validate the string.

inputs.name: EvidenceBranchRepository.add.directory
inputs.description: Directory prefix joined with each file path for placement and with key for the existing-record lookup. This class does not validate the resulting path.

inputs.name: EvidenceBranchRepository.add.files
inputs.description: Files added under directory when a new commit is made; a file whose path equals key supplies the bytes used to recognize an identical existing entry. If that file is absent or lacks matching byte content, an existing entry is refused.

inputs.name: EvidenceBranchRepository.add.message
inputs.description: Git commit message used when adding a new evidence-tree commit. It is not used for an identical existing record.

inputs.name: EvidenceBranchRepository.add.key
inputs.description: Relative file path combined with directory to locate the identifying content and check whether that record already exists. When an existing entry is found, the corresponding supplied file must expose matching bytes.

outputs.name: EvidenceBranchRepository.tip
outputs.description: Current commit hash at the evidence ref, or undefined when the ref has no tip. The value identifies a commit in the evidence history.

outputs.name: EvidenceBranchRepository.add
outputs.description: The commit associated with the keyed entry and whether this call created a new commit. For an identical existing entry, commit is found from the key file history and falls back to the current tip if that lookup yields no commit.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised when add finds different bytes at the existing directory/key path, or after 20 unsuccessful attempts to advance the evidence ref.
